products.sourceTitle: All Day, Small Group, Luxury Wine Tour with Gourmet Lunch

productOptions.title: All day, small group, luxury wine tour with gourmet lunch

products.unstructuredDescription: Pick up is at 8.45am at your hotel in the Mendoza City area.  We visit three wineries throughout the day and have premum tastings including Malbec at each winery.  At the first winery we also do a tour of the facility to see what makes Argentine so unique. Each winery we visit is very different and we include small boutique operations and larger, big name wineries. We then have a 5-course gourmet lunch with 5 wines at a winery with beautiful mountan views. We return to your Mendoza City hotel at 5.30pm.  The group size is maximum eight people and the price includes tastings and lunch with wine. A guide accompanies you all day and the tour is conducted in an air-conditioned Mercedes mini-bus.  Mineral water is provided in the transport vehicle.
